title: Verify European dynamic fragment usage diagnostics
changes: Document production CLI emission of the dynamic-fragment usage counters.
validation: An isolated Windows production build and one Wine neutral-frame startup emitted the new resource line with zero counters while reusing the accepted e100 directory; 93 managed files and all guarded inputs remained unchanged.
limitations: Zero counts cover only this frame; ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
